content.text: {"comps":[{"label":"C1","good":false,"reason":"Makes wellheads and pressure control equipment for oil wells; NPK rents composite matting and offers site planning and remediation."},{"label":"C2","good":false,"reason":"Self-performs site grading, utilities and paving with asphalt and stone; NPK sells and rents temporary composite matting."},{"label":"C3","good":false,"reason":"Builds roads and bridges with its own asphalt and aggregates; NPK makes and rents temporary composite access matting."},{"label":"C4","good":false,"reason":"Distributes plumbing, HVAC and waterworks products to contractors; NPK manufactures and rents matting for site access."},{"label":"C5","good":false,"reason":"Develops raw land into residential lots sold to homebuilders; NPK rents temporary matting and provides remediation services."},{"label":"C6","good":false,"reason":"Builds highways and water infrastructure under public contracts and makes aggregates; NPK rents composite matting."},{"label":"C7","good":false,"reason":"Manufactures pre-insulated piping for district energy and pipelines; NPK makes composite matting and grounding systems."},{"label":"C8","good":false,"reason":"Sells coatings, sealants and roofing systems across consumer and industrial markets; NPK rents composite site-access matting."},{"label":"C9","good":false,"reason":"Casts precast concrete barriers, culverts and modular buildings; NPK manufactures and rents composite matting."},{"label":"C10","good":false,"reason":"Provides drilling, completion and intervention services to oil operators; NPK rents matting and offers site planning and remediation."}]}
